mapper.select: select s.name as supplier_name, s.email, s.phone_number, s.postal_code, s.prefecture, s.city, s.street_address, s.building_name, pt.name as paymentTermName, s.is_active as active from supplier s join payment_term pt on s.payment_term_id = pt.payment_term_id where supplier_id = #{supplierId};
